summary: Frontend-only testing for Light Theme Mode feature. All theme toggle features verified working. Fixed critical bug in Pipeline.js where DealCard and StageColumn components were using undefined 'colors' variable.

settings_appearance_section.test_result: PASSED - Appearance section visible in Settings sidebar with Palette icon

theme_toggle_dark_light.test_result: PASSED - Theme toggle between Dark and Light modes works correctly

light_theme_mainlayout.test_result: PASSED - MainLayout background changes to light gray (#f5f5f7), sidebar to white

light_theme_dashboard.test_result: PASSED - Dashboard shows white cards, dark text in light mode

theme_persistence_localstorage.test_result: PASSED - Theme preference persists in localStorage as 'dl-theme'

switch_back_to_dark.test_result: PASSED - Switching back to Dark restores original dark look

pipeline_page_both_themes.test_result: PASSED - Pipeline page loads correctly in both themes after fix

no_console_errors.test_result: PASSED - No console errors when switching themes (after fix)

pipeline_colors_undefined.description: ReferenceError: colors is not defined in StageColumn component
pipeline_colors_undefined.root_cause: DealCard and StageColumn components were defined outside Pipeline component but used 'colors' and 'shadows' variables that were only defined inside Pipeline component
pipeline_colors_undefined.fix_applied: Added useTheme hook and getThemeColors/getThemeShadows calls to both DealCard and StageColumn components

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.js: Clean implementation using localStorage and data-theme attribute on html element
designSystem.js: Well-structured dark/light color palettes with getThemeColors helper
Settings.js AppearanceSection: Good UX with visual theme preview cards and checkmark indicator
MainLayout.js: Properly uses isDark from useTheme and getThemeColors for dynamic styling
Dashboard.js: Correctly implements theme-aware styling using getThemeColors
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light theme mode feature fully working. Fixed Pipeline.js bug where DealCard and StageColumn components needed useTheme hook. Theme toggle works via Settings > Appearance. Theme persists in localStorage as 'dl-theme'. All pages (Dashboard, Pipeline, Settings) properly support both dark and light themes.
